before.title: Pending-migration preflight can disagree with startup's stored model catalog
before.body:
Origin: the independent Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh review of #448, [original review](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/448#issuecomment-7060237320). This is a pre-existing P3 follow-up, outside #448's bounded missing-seed projection. Source is signed main `02351e2fb932b3be44e7cc3fb3943a61d568226c`; the reviewed candidate preserves this behavior. This record is not implementation or acceptance.

When migrations are pending, `runPreflight` uses the shipped default catalog (`apps/api/src/preflight.ts:366`) instead of stored rows and describes it as the catalog seeded on first start. Ordinary startup can read a current-format store through `readPreMigrationModelCatalog` and admits from stored rows plus missing seeds before migrating. Offline and ordinary startup can therefore disagree about a stored model, disabled flag or supported effort on this path. This finding is source-backed; the review did not execute a new pending-migration reproduction.

Acceptance when separately dispatched:
- Independently reproduce a current-format/pending-migration store where stored metadata differs from shipped seeds; include a clean migrated store, missing store and unsupported/unreadable store.
- Define a truthful read-only pre-migration admission result consistent with the startup guard where safe. If a model projection cannot safely be inspected, distinguish that limit rather than asserting unsupported model or ready execution from unrelated seed data.
- Never migrate, seed, refresh, create or alter the inspected database/WAL; preserve the SQLite SHM reader exception and failure closure of unsupported formats.
- Keep stored owner disablement, provider/account readiness, and model-retirement policy separate; no automatic model substitution.
- Verify the public command/startup distinction and update documentation under normal review/QA/coverage/CI gates.

Duplicate check included open/closed preflight-title, pending-migration/catalog and startup/seed searches. #448 explicitly handles current migrated stores; #179 is CLI prerequisite capability, and #495 is aliased-checkout repository guards. This is a separate pre-existing path. Delivery: parked backlog, no implementation gate; proposed Sol xhigh implementation and Opus xhigh review. Not added to the current 26-core-issue batch.
